title: Legacy prediction recovery — supplementary only
source: Supabase predictions + pre-off odds_snapshots + official NAR daily payouts
scope: 2026-11-05 only; predictions saved before scheduled post time; at least 7 runners; closest odds snapshot captured after prediction and before post with minutes_to_post >= 2.
strict_g4_note: Only 1 of 40 races had prediction-to-odds age <=15 minutes. This report must not be merged into the official G4 prospective evaluation or used to change the live model.
blend_method: Per-horse model probabilities normalized to sum 1 and market probabilities derived from inverse win odds normalized to sum 1; ranking score = 50% model + 50% market. Exploratory only.
